subject: Post-discovery: 30-minute product walkthrough — timing & attendees
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@peregrine-systems.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-minute product walkthrough — timing & attendees

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Peregrine is prioritizing lower-latency inference for your document ingest pipeline and needs predictable token costs for peak loads. You mentioned compliance constraints around log retention and an upcoming procurement review in Q3.

Next step we discussed: a 30-minute product walkthrough (high-level demo + ops/readiness discussion) to include your engineering lead and the security/compliance owner if possible. To keep this efficient, proposed agenda attached (redwood-30m-agenda.pdf) and my short notes from the call (peregrine-discovery-notes.pdf).

Please pick whichever of these 2–3 windows works best for your group — I can lock the invite once you confirm attendees: 
- Tue June 25 — 11:00–11:30 PT
- Wed June 26 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu June 27 — 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, send 2–3 alternative half-hour slots and I’ll match on our side. Also, do you prefer a short pre-read before the walkthrough (1 pager) or we use the first five minutes for context?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0179
attachments: peregrine-discovery-notes.pdf, redwood-30m-agenda.pdf

From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@peregrine-systems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-minute product walkthrough — timing & attendees

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the summary and the attach — nice write-up. Wed June 26 14:00–14:30 PT works best for us. Please include Tom Greene (Head of Engineering) and I’ll add Priya (security/compliance) to the calendar invite once you have it.

Two quick asks before the walkthrough: 
1) Can the demo touch on peak batching behavior for 2k token requests?
2) We’ll need a short note on data retention defaults for hosted deployments (to share with procurement).

If you want to loop anyone from your side for infra/readiness detail, please do. Otherwise we’ll keep it: Karthik, Priyom (if available), Tom, me, and Priya (security).

Thanks — Samira
Samira Patel
Director, Platform Engineering | Peregrine Systems
samira.patel@peregrine-systems.com
phone: (415) 222-3141

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@peregrine-systems.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-minute product walkthrough — timing & attendees

Samira — great, Wed 26 14:00 PT locked. I’ve added Priyom (Solutions Engineer) and Laura (Sales Manager) to help cover both the technical and procurement/commercial bits. Agenda is attached again for convenience.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- Peak batching: we’ll show a 2k-token example and call out how our autoscaling + batching keeps 95th percentile latency under your target while smoothing costs. Priyom will handle the demo snippet.
- Data retention: I’ve attached a one-page summary of default retention settings for hosted customers and the steps for configuring retention windows or turning on longer retention for audit purposes. If you’d prefer formal procurement language, Laura can follow up with the specific clause we surface in contracts.

Calendar invite (Google): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-peregrine-30m — I’ll send the invite to the addresses on this thread.

See you Wed. If anyone needs to swap, reply-all and propose alternates.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-30m-agenda.pdf, peregrine-discovery-notes.pdf

From: Tom Greene <t.greene@peregrine-systems.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Samira Patel <samira.patel@peregrine-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2024 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-minute product walkthrough — timing & attendees

Thanks Karthik — confirmed on my end for Wed 26 14:00 PT. I’ll bring a couple of infra questions around SLO enforcement and our current batching layer. Priya will be added to the invite.

Tom Greene
Head of Engineering | Peregrine Systems
notes: Thread contains realistic post-discovery scheduling, short replies, attachments as stubs. Internal participants are sales/solutions/manager roles.
